race.comment: VEGA SICILIA (10) finished out of the money two starts back then he got a long way back and was beaten 6 lengths when seventh over 1950m at Ipswich eight days ago. Yet to place in 10 runs but this is easier and gets a chance. FLIRTING WITH FIRE (7) finished 2.5 lengths away in fifth last time out over 1920m at this track two weeks ago as $3.8 favourite. Tackles a longer journey this time. Wound up late here last time and among the chances. MOANA NUI (9) is a nine-start maiden who finished fifth at his most recent outing over 1700m at Ipswich. Nicely placed and expected to go well. ACTS ALONE (2) ran a better race last start to finish a close third over 1920m at this track after missing the placings at the previous appearance. Top run at big odds and among the chances with a repeat. JOSEPHINE OF TUFFY (5) has a tricky gate but will give a sight.
